description_en: Queries the device-level capabilities supported by an Express Connect circuit
description_zh: 查询物理专线支持的设备级能力
kebab_example: aliyun vpc list-physical-connection-features --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --physical-connection-id pc-bp1qrb3044eqixog0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPhysicalConnectionFeatures

parameters.help_en:

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect circuit
parameters.name: physical_connection_id

PhysicalConnectionFeatures.description_en: The list of Express Connect circuit attributes

items.description_en: The list of Express Connect circuit attributes

FeatureKey.description_en:
The attribute key of the Express Connect circuit. Valid values:

SubifRateLimit: sub-interface rate limiting.
BFD能力: Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) capability.
DualStack: the capability to support both IPv4 and IPv6.
CEN: when a Virtual Border Router (VBR) is attached to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, the original route attributes such as as-path and community can be carried when advertising BGP routes to the user side.
CENv6: when a VBR is attached to an IPv6-enabled CEN instance, the original route attributes such as as-path and community can be carried when advertising BGP routes to the user side.
QOS: the device supports configuring QoS policies on physical ports.
MSHA: the device supports configuring a fast failover group between two VBRs.
MULTI_MS_HA: the device supports configuring a fast failover group among up to 8 VBRs. These VBRs must be added to the same Express Connect Router (ECR)
FeatureKey.description_zh:
物理专线的特性键。取值：

SubifRateLimit：子接口限速。
BFD能力：BFD能力。
DualStack：同时支持IPv4和IPv6的能力。
CEN：当VBR加载到CEN中，向用户侧宣告BGP路由时，可以携带路由原始as-path，community等属性。
CENv6：当VBR加载到IPv6的CEN中，向向用户侧宣告BGP路由时，可以携带路由原始as-path，community等属性。
QOS：设备支持在物理端口配置QOS策略。
MSHA：设备支持在两个VBR之间配置快速倒换组。
MULTI_MS_HA：设备支持在个最多8个VBR之间配置快速倒换组，需要这些VBR加入到同一个ECR中

FeatureValue.description_en:
The attribute value of the Express Connect circuit. Valid values:

OK: Supported.
NOK: Not supported
FeatureValue.description_zh:
物理专线的特性值。取值：

OK：支持。
NOK：不支持
